stop_conditions.artifact_bytes_scope: stop_conditions.artifact_bytes counts the data payloads present before report.json is written; artifact_bytes_estimate_including_report is the fixed-point data-plus-report total, calculated excluding manifest.json; manifest.json.total_bytes sums its listed files, excluding manifest.json, and equals that data-plus-report total; manifest.json.final_artifact_bytes adds the exact manifest size and is the artifact-limit total.

claims.scope: training-only learnability evidence over prepared04 training rows; no development, held-out or audit payload is read and no learned-quality claim is made

limitations: Two paired training stages only; no evaluation split is read.
The mean-only ablation removes within-image spatial residual while preserving each image's mean projected patch; it is not a test of a global dataset mean or of residual-zero projections.
Mean preservation and spatial collapse are asserted only within the declared 1e-6 tolerance.
Attempt02 retained first-token scalars, NLL and generations but not full logits; baseline identity cannot reconstruct full logit tensors.
The decision rule is first-order evidence only and authorizes at most the separate gradient diagnostic, never V0.
Sampled MPS and host telemetry cannot guarantee the absence of a transient allocation.
A not-established or baseline-mismatch decision stops the vision sequence; no automatic retry is performed.
